channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Lawmakers seek answers on the national security as Nvidia CEO returns
item.description: Lawmakers from both parties are escalating calls to tighten controls on advanced AI chips, as national security questions persist in the wake of Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.
item.content:encoded: Lawmakers from both parties are escalating calls to tighten controls on advanced AI chips, as national security questions persist in the wake of Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.
item.dc:creator: Shannon Bond

item.title: Republican wants FBI and CIA answers before questioning Nvidia chief
item.description: "The public is rightly concerned," says the Republican lawmaker, who wants to know what the FBI and CIA knew about potential national security threats and whether Jensen Huang was warned.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: U.S. government investigating Iranian ties to as many as 50 hacked commercial vessels
item.description: A U.S. official tells NPR the government is investigating cyberattacks against as many as 50 commercial ships, with Iran as the potential culprit.
